source_of_difference: Phase 4 report mistakenly quoted a draft figure (49,555) from an intermediate trial testing knockout rule inclusion. The verified canonical CSV count on disk has always been exactly 48,574 balls faced (51,079 regular deliveries minus 2,505 wides).

Phase 4 report used 193,251 minus the 49,555 placeholder. The verified canonical count on disk is 144,677 balls faced (149,882 regular deliveries minus 5,205 wides). Exactly conserves 48,574 + 144,677 = 193,251.

Phase 4 report mistakenly quoted a draft figure (23,088) from an experimental test where Over 15 was included in P1. The verified canonical CSV count on disk has always been exactly 22,725 legal balls (24,107 regular deliveries minus 1,235 wides and 147 no-balls).

Phase 4 report used 192,412 minus the 23,088 placeholder. The verified canonical count on disk is 169,687 legal balls (176,854 regular deliveries minus 6,475 wides and 692 no-balls). Exactly conserves 22,725 + 169,687 = 192,412.
